# Turkish Journal of Child and Adolescent Mental Health

> An open-access academic journal dedicated to publishing peer-reviewed research on child and adolescent mental health, psychiatry, and related healthcare topics.

Published by Galenos Publishing House in partnership with the Turkish Association for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, this journal serves as a primary platform for disseminating research and clinical insights in child and adolescent mental health across Turkish and international audiences. The journal maintains rigorous editorial standards and is indexed in multiple abstracting databases.

## Key Topics

- Child and adolescent mental health
- Child and adolescent psychiatry
- Open-access publishing
- Peer review

- Autism Spectrum Disorder
